briefs.claim_en: Two crocodiles were seen in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru yesterday evening.
briefs.brief_en: Available local news reports establish that Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru is a documented habitat for mugger crocodiles, with occasional sightings reported over time. The Hindu reported a marsh crocodile sighting near the lake bund on March 26, 2010. Star of Mysore documented individual sightings on December 1, 2024, and on January 28, 2026, near Rangayana. A subsequent report by Star of Mysore on September 7, 2026, noted visitor safety concerns and warning signs around the water body. However, none of the retrieved reports corroborate a sighting of two crocodiles occurring specifically on the evening of October 15, 2026.
gaps_en: No news reports or official statements found regarding crocodile sightings on October 15, 2026.
No corroboration found regarding the presence of two crocodiles simultaneously.
